### Remembering God's Faithfulness Through Every Life Transition
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/remembering-gods-faithfulness-through-every-life-transition.html
Passage: Psalm 36:5
Points:
- Significant life transitions frequently trigger grief, anxiety, and deep uncertainty.
- Psalm 36:5 anchors believers in the reality that God's loving faithfulness has no limits.
- Reflecting on how God faithfully provided during past trials helps calm current worries.
- Believers do not need full foresight when trusting the unchanging character of God.

### The Light We Need to See: How Christ Dispels Spiritual Darkness
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-light-we-need-to-see
Passage: Psalm 36:9
Points:
- Spiritual light and life are fundamentally intertwined gifts that flow directly from God.
- The darkness of human wickedness deceives people into trusting their own moral blindness.
- Divine light exposes spiritual danger, shows the true path, and gives spiritual vitality.
- Jesus embodies the light of Psalm 36:9, overcoming our darkness and sharing His life.
